title: Google\Cloud\Dialogflow\V2\EntityType\Entity
name: Entity
description: An entity entry for an associated entity type.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.value
params.description: Required. The primary value associated with this entity entry. For example, if the entity type is vegetable, the value could be scallions. For KIND_MAP entity types: A reference value to be used in place of synonyms. For KIND_LIST entity types: A string that can contain references to other entity types (with or without aliases).

params.name: data.synonyms
params.description: Required. A collection of value synonyms. For example, if the entity type is vegetable, and value is scallions, a synonym could be green onions. For KIND_LIST entity types: * This collection must contain exactly one synonym equal to value.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Required. The primary value associated with this entity entry.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Required. The primary value associated with this entity entry.

methods.name: getSynonyms
methods.description: Required. A collection of value synonyms. For example, if the entity type is vegetable, and value is scallions, a synonym could be green onions.

methods.name: setSynonyms
methods.description: Required. A collection of value synonyms. For example, if the entity type is vegetable, and value is scallions, a synonym could be green onions.
